name: Qualcomm CDR (CAD Hedged)
summary: QUALCOMM, Inc. develops and commercializes core technologies and products found in mobile handsets and in further wireless products. It reports Qualcomm CDMA Technologies, Qualcomm Technology Licensing and Qualcomm Strategic Initiatives segments. The CDMA Technologies segment supplies system software and integrated circuits for multimedia, GPS, networking, application processing and voice and data communications products.
